gen_risks.description: Topographic challenges and sparse population in forested and tribal areas hinder physical access to senior secondary schools, causing high dropout rates among adolescent boys.
gen_risks.mitigation: Establish residential facilities for boys in topographically complex areas and implement a hub-and-spoke model with transport allowance support.
gen_risks.evidence: in some areas, students face topographic challenges in accessing senior secondary schools, in which case boys are left at a disadvantage.

gen_risks.description: Extreme weather events including heat waves, droughts, and floods cause unexpected school closures, shortening the instructional calendar and deepening learning losses.
gen_risks.mitigation: Develop disaster-resilient school infrastructure, integrate climate education, and deploy digitally enabled assessment and remote catch-up learning tools.
gen_risks.evidence: vulnerable to droughts and floods due to erratic monsoons and heat waves that can force extensions of the annual school summer break

gen_risks.description: Economic opportunities in informal labor and seasonal farm work encourage adolescent boys in secondary grades to drop out before completion.
gen_risks.mitigation: Expand senior secondary science and commerce streams aligned with job market demand, provide targeted remedial education, and conduct parental community engagement.
gen_risks.evidence: adolescent boys in secondary and senior secondary grades find it economically beneficial to drop out and take up informal jobs available in the labor market.

gen_risks.description: Severe shortages of specialized Science, Mathematics, and English teachers lead to language teachers instructing STEM courses, undermining learning quality.
gen_risks.mitigation: Provide structured grade/subject-specific lesson plans, implement flexible teacher hiring in semi-autonomous composite model schools, and offer continuous need-based training.
gen_risks.evidence: lack of subject teachers in schools managed by the GoCG has resulted in Language teachers teaching Mathematics, English, and Sciences.

gen_risks.description: Multi-tiered planning and implementation processes coupled with limited capacity lead to delayed AWP&B approvals, slow fund releases, and budget under-execution.
gen_risks.mitigation: Conduct financial management studies to streamline decentralized budgeting, deploy a dedicated PMC, and implement multi-tier fiduciary capacity building.
gen_risks.evidence: multiple tiers of planning and implementation and their limited capacities to prepare and manage budgets often result in inadequately planned budgeting

gen_risks.description: Fragmented school management and low primary school enrolment result in multi-grade teaching and high per-pupil operating costs.
gen_risks.mitigation: Consolidate school network operations into 600 model composite schools (Grades K-12) to achieve economies of scale and optimize teacher deployment.
gen_risks.evidence: fragmented school functioning have led to multi-grade teaching and higher per-pupil expenditure.

gen_risks.description: Absence of a standardized diagnostic assessment system and weak analytical capacity at the SCERT Assessment Cell prevent effective identification of student learning deficiencies.
gen_risks.mitigation: Engage technical assistance under the IPF component to build SAC capacity, establish periodic state-level achievement surveys, and digitize school-based diagnostic assessments.
gen_risks.evidence: lack of a standardized system to assess student learning through a diagnostic lens restricts the nodal educational institutions' ability to identify issue(s)

gen_risks.description: Persistent internal financial control deficiencies and unresolved statutory audit observations dating back to FY 2009-10 increase fiduciary risks.
gen_risks.mitigation: Establish a dedicated Audit Committee, hold district and block audit clearance camps, strengthen risk-based internal auditing, and deploy automated accounting modules.
gen_risks.evidence: deviations are observed in the implementation of the laid-out controls... unresolved/ addressed statutory observations since FY 2009-10.

gen_risks.description: Lack of systemic annual procurement planning and dedicated procurement complaint handling mechanisms creates fiduciary exposure and potential contracting delays.
gen_risks.mitigation: Mandate annual procurement plan preparation, conduct independent procurement audits, and launch an online procurement complaint redressal portal on the SIS-SS website.
gen_risks.evidence: assessment found that there is no practice of preparing an annual procurement plan... no dedicated mechanism in place to treat procurement-related complaints

gen_risks.description: Inexperience of SIS-SS staff with World Bank Procurement Regulations for consultancy services risks delays in selecting key technical agencies, PMC, and IVA.
gen_risks.mitigation: Provide handholding support and World Bank procurement training, deploy experienced procurement specialists within the PMC, and utilize STEP for project tracking.
gen_risks.evidence: Procurement risks related to the IPF component include the inexperience of the SIS-SS to process consultancy services following World Bank Procurement Regulations

gen_risks.description: Civil works for expanding model composite schools may cause noise/air pollution, improper construction/e-waste disposal, and occupational and community health hazards.
gen_risks.mitigation: Incorporate standard Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) clauses into bidding documents, implement site screening checklists, and enforce national waste management rules.
gen_risks.evidence: air/noise pollution in mining areas, dust and disposal of construction waste... Occupational Health and Safety (OHS) and Community Health and Safety (CHS) issues

gen_risks.description: Inadequate fire safety features and lack of universal physical accessibility in school buildings compromise safety and exclude students with disabilities.
gen_risks.mitigation: Enforce mandatory architectural design protocols integrating fire safety equipment, multiple emergency exits, and universal access ramps across all model composite school civil works.
gen_risks.evidence: gap in following any fire safety norms in the schools, (c) lack of provisions for universal access to students and teachers

gen_risks.description: Overcrowding in tribal hostels due to uncoordinated infrastructure planning risks worsening living conditions, health, and academic performance for Scheduled Tribe students.
gen_risks.mitigation: Perform geographic and needs-based infrastructure assessments in collaboration with the Department of Tribal and Scheduled Caste to expand hostel capacities safely.
gen_risks.evidence: over-crowding of students in tribal hostels, (g) lack of geographic and needs-based planning to ensure equity and access

gen_risks.description: National economic transitions away from coal mining risk worsening local employment and socio-economic conditions in coal-dependent blocks of Chhattisgarh.
gen_risks.mitigation: Target at least 5% of model composite school developments in coal mining blocks to equip local youth with science and commerce education for alternative career paths.
gen_risks.evidence: endorsements for clean technology will result in the gradual closure of coal mines... There will be a need for reskilling/upskilling for alternative jobs.

gen_risks.description: Inadequate staffing and technical expertise at SCERT, SIEMAT, and SAC could slow down the development of need-based teacher training and leadership modules.
gen_risks.mitigation: Contract specialized technical support agencies and consultants under the IPF component to augment capacity and transfer institutional knowledge to state agencies.
gen_risks.evidence: addressing a few technical gaps that might exist in the current institutional setup; and (b) supplementary (temporary) human resources availability

gen_risks.description: Complex multi-agency implementation involving SIS-SS, PWD, RES, and DoTSC risks coordination bottlenecks in civil works execution and facility maintenance.
gen_risks.mitigation: Establish formal inter-departmental service-level agreements, joint coordination protocols, and a centralized monitoring dashboard at DoSE.
gen_risks.evidence: requires the capacity enhancement and further strengthening of coordination mechanisms with other GoCG departments and stakeholders both at state and district levels.

gen_risks.description: Lack of seamless technical interface between PFMS, Single Nodal Accounts (SNA), and commercial banks risks delays in transferring funds to sub-district units.
gen_risks.mitigation: Provide targeted training to banking and administrative staff, establish zero-balance child accounts for sub-implementing agencies, and conduct periodic reconciliation.
gen_risks.evidence: lack of effective information interface between the PFMS system and the Banking network... increased reliance on the banking network has become a bottleneck

gen_risks.description: Collection and digital storage of student and teacher personal data across state EMIS and assessment dashboards expose the project to privacy breach risks.
gen_risks.mitigation: Ensure digital platforms adhere to national data protection frameworks, anonymize sensitive student records, and conduct technical privacy impact assessments.
gen_risks.evidence: Operation’s activities involving collection, storage, usage, and/or processing of Personal Data are carried out with due regard to the Borrower’s existing legal framework

gt_risks.description: Political and Governance risk is rated Substantial. State elections are due in December 2023 and the associated large democratic exercise could slow down activities envisioned for the first year of the operation. The window between the operation being declared effective and the state elections is small.
gt_risks.mitigation: Disruptions are expected to be minimal given that the state intends to initiate work and complete necessary field work and/or data collection well before the elections, and utilize the election period for analysis and training module/materials development. The implementing bodies (SIS-SS, SCERT, SIEMAT, and SAC) will need to move swiftly to realize the state's plans.

gt_risks.description: Technical Design of operation risk is rated Substantial. Certain context-specific attributes such as topography and underlying community representation in overall enrolment could raise challenges, including barriers to school enrolment such as lack of physical access in sparsely populated areas with poor road connectivity, or high opportunity cost of schooling due to informal-sector employment.
gt_risks.mitigation: The Government of Chhattisgarh has addressed similar challenges in the past through development and rollout of customized solutions; the project will enable planning for residential facilities for students and teachers in model schools in topographically hard-to-reach areas.

gt_risks.description: Institutional Capacity for Implementation and Sustainability risk is rated Substantial. In some cases, nodal educational institutions lack the expertise to implement technically complex interventions.
gt_risks.mitigation: Onboarding a Program Management Consultant (PMC) and technical support agencies is expected to significantly reduce the risks involved. Sustainability post-completion will be ensured through careful planning, technical support for capacity building of nodal institutions, and institutionalizing new mechanisms.

gt_risks.description: Fiduciary risk is rated Substantial. Considering the implementing arrangements and diverse capacity across implementing agencies, implementation constraints can be foreseen in public financial management arrangements and compliance with rules and regulations for accountability.
gt_risks.mitigation: Focused attention in the short/medium term on enhanced effectiveness of planning, budgeting, and fund flow processes; adequacy of staffing and capacity building of fiduciary staff; strengthened monitoring through internal and external independent reviews; timely resolution of independent external review observations; a robust dedicated procurement complaints redressal system; strengthened contract management for delivery of goods and works; and ensuring exclusion of Bank-debarred firms from high-value contracts.
